purpose: Prospectively extend the published-equation scalar circular initial-state and 35-mode pre-NQC flux comparison across a compact mass-ratio, aligned-spin, and start-frequency grid.
source_scope: Bohé et al. 1611.03703v3 Eqs. (4)-(6), (9); Buonanno-Chen-Damour gr-qc/0508067v2 Eqs. (70)-(77); published factorized-mode equations enumerated in the reference manifest.
interpretation: A pass strengthens only the conditional paper-derived leaf. It does not identify the historical v4 flux switches or Cartesian root procedure, validate integration/convergence, close V4-ODE-IC or V4-FLUX-4-9, qualify the native model for release, or add it to public catalogs.
